ghcnd_<N>: Daily station-level observation values: one row per station/date/element (columns: id, date, element, value, mflag, qflag, sflag, time).
ghcnd_states: US state lookup: one row per state (columns: code, name, source_url, etl_timestamp).
ghcnd_stations: Weather station metadata: one row per station (columns: id, latitude, longitude, elevation, state, name, gsn_flag, hcn_crn_flag, wmoid, source_url, etl_timestamp).
ghcnd_countries: Country lookup for stations: one row per country (columns: code, name, source_url, etl_timestamp).
ghcnd_inventory: Station element coverage inventory: one row per station/element (columns: id, latitude, longitude, element, firstyear, lastyear, source_url, etl_timestamp).
tlc_yellow_trips_<N>: Yellow taxi trip records: one row per taxi trip (columns: vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, passenger_count, trip_distance, pickup_longitude, pickup_latitude, rate_code, store_and_fwd_flag, dropoff_longitude, dropoff_latitude, payment_type, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, imp_surcharge, total_amount).
tree_census_<N>: Street-tree census points: one row per tree record (columns: recordid, address, house_number, street, zip_original, cb_original, site, species, diameter, status, wires, sidewalk_condition, support_structure, borough, x, y, longitude, latitude, cb_new, zip_new, censustract_2010, censusblock_2010, nta_2010, segmentid, spc_common, spc_latin, location).
tlc_fhv_trips_<N>: For-hire vehicle (FHVs) pickup events: one row per FHV pickup (columns: location_id, pickup_datetime, dispatching_base_num, borough, zone, service_zone).
tlc_green_trips_<N>: Green taxi trip records: one row per green taxi trip (columns: vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, store_and_fwd_flag, rate_code, pickup_longitude, pickup_latitude, dropoff_longitude, dropoff_latitude, passenger_count, trip_distance, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, ehail_fee, total_amount, payment_type, distance_between_service, time_between_service, trip_type, imp_surcharge).
citibike_stations: Citibike docking station status/metadata: one row per station snapshot or station (columns: station_id, name, short_name, latitude, longitude, region_id, rental_methods, capacity, eightd_has_key_dispenser, num_bikes_available, num_bikes_disabled, num_docks_available, num_docks_disabled, is_installed, is_renting, is_returning, eightd_has_available_keys, last_reported).
tree_species: Tree species reference: one row per species (columns: species_scientific_name, species_common_name, form, growth_rate, fall_color, environmental_tolerances, location_tolerances, notes_suggested_cultivars, tree_size, comments).
citibike_trips: Individual Citibike trips: one row per bike trip (columns: tripduration, starttime, stoptime, start_station_id, start_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_id, end_station_name, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude, bikeid, usertype, birth_year, gender).
311_service_requests: Holds individual 311 service request incidents (one row per service request, identified by unique_key) with timestamps (created_date, closed_date, due_date, resolution_action_updated_date), agency/agency_name, complaint_type and descriptor, status and resolution_description, full address fields (incident_address, street_name, cross_street_1, cross_street_2, intersection_street_1, intersection_street_2, address_type, city, landmark, borough, incident_zip, bbl), location context (location_type, facility_type, park_facility_name, park_borough, bridge_highway_name, bridge_highway_direction, bridge_highway_segment, road_ramp), administrative fields (community_board, open_data_channel_type), vehicle/taxi fields (vehicle_type, taxi_company_borough, taxi_pickup_location), spatial coordinates (x_coordinate, y_coordinate, latitude, longitude).
nypd_mv_collisions: Contains motor-vehicle collision reports (one row per collision incident, keyed by unique_key) with occurrence time (timestamp), location fields (on_street_name, off_street_name, cross_street_name, location, borough, zip_code, latitude, longitude), contributing factors for up to five vehicles (contributing_factor_vehicle_1..5), vehicle type codes for up to five vehicles (vehicle_type_code1, vehicle_type_code2, vehicle_type_code_3, vehicle_type_code_4, vehicle_type_code_5), and injury/fatality counts (number_of_persons_injured, number_of_persons_killed, number_of_cyclist_injured, number_of_cyclist_killed, number_of_pedestrians_injured, number_of_pedestrians_killed, number_of_motorist_injured, number_of_motorist_killed).
